title: Luna
html:
Luna is a cosmic map in OpenFront. As of Update 34.0 it is no longer part of the public game rotation, but it can still be picked for custom lobbies and single player.

Nations

The map features 25 named nations, including Apollo 12, Apollo 14, Apollo 15, Apollo 11, Apollo 16 and Apollo 17.

Details

  • Categories: Cosmic
  • Nations: 25
  • Public rotation frequency: removed from public rotation in Update 34.0 (was 6)
